name: Liquid Tab Bar
description: Bottom tab bar with four icon tabs and a liquid blob indicator that morphs and slides to the selected tab while the icon switches from outline to filled.
contents: Rounded tab bar with four icon buttons (home, chat, folder, user)
Morphing goo indicator under the active tab
behavior: Clicking a tab morphs the indicator path, lifts a droplet and slides the indicator to the new tab
Active icon swaps from outline to filled through a circular clip reveal
Indicator position is recalculated on window resize
editableByProps: Indicator and icon color, bar background color
Accessible labels, initially active tab, tab change callback

needsCodeEdit.change: Change the tab icons or their number
Change the blob morph shapes or timing
needsCodeEdit.where: morphSVG keyframes in handleTabClick and MORPH_REST constant

fixed: Root fills the viewport height and centers its content. Override with className using an important modifier such as !h-auto.
Requires the gsap package including gsap/MorphSVGPlugin
Bar width is capped at 375px and shrinks to fit narrow screens
Uses a fixed SVG filter id, so only one instance per page is safe
